newsitem.title: USA: Geltex stake raised by Gerhard group.
newsitem.headline: Geltex stake raised by Gerhard group.

text.p: A group including Greenbrae, Calif., investor Lang Gerhard and West Highland Capital Inc said Wednesday it raised its stake in GelTex Pharmaceuticals Inc to 7.4 percent or 1 million common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it purchased a net of 145,010 shares between Dec. 19 and Jan. 9 at prices ranging from $22.8750 to $25.3125 per share.
The group previously held a 6.4 percent stake or 860,000 shares.
It said it holds the stake for investment.
